title: Spotting a step out of place
idea: A plan can have all the right steps but in the wrong order. Find and fix the misplaced step.

exercises.prompt: Plan: show Bye, show Hello. Task wanted Hello first. What's the fix?
options: Swap them: show Hello first, then Bye
exercises.explanation: The steps are right but reversed. Swap them so Hello comes first, as the task asked.

exercises.prompt: A plan can have every correct step and still be wrong because of the order.
exercises.explanation: Yes. Right steps, wrong order equals wrong result. Order is part of being correct.

exercises.prompt: Task: show the title, then the author. Fix this plan into the right order.
exercises.explanation: Title first, author second — the order the task asked for.

exercises.prompt: Code: print("Second") then print("First"). Task wanted First then Second. What's wrong?
options: The two print lines are out of order
exercises.explanation: Both lines exist but they're swapped. Put print("First") above print("Second").

exercises.prompt: Task: show Ready, then Set, then Go. Fix the order.
exercises.explanation: Ready, Set, Go — the only order that makes sense here.

exercises.prompt: A plan shows a goodbye in the MIDDLE, before the main message. Is that sensible?
options: There is no way to tell
exercises.explanation: A goodbye out of place reads oddly. Think about what order makes sense for the reader.

exercises.prompt: Task: show Welcome, then the guest's name, then Enjoy. Order the code lines correctly.
exercises.explanation: Welcome, name, Enjoy — the plan's order carried straight into the code.

exercises.prompt: To fix a step that's out of place, you move it — you don't need to delete it.
exercises.explanation: Right. The step is correct; it just needs to be in the right spot. Move, don't delete.

exercises.prompt: Which has the RIGHT steps but the WRONG order for 'greet, then name'?
options: Show the name, then show the greeting
Show the greeting, then show the name
Show the weather, then the name
exercises.explanation: Both steps are correct, but swapped — name before greeting. The second option is the right order.

exercises.prompt: Task: show Hello, show your name, show Goodbye. Put the plan in the correct order.
exercises.explanation: Hello, name, Goodbye. You can now spot AND fix an out-of-place step. Strong work!
